verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show PlanetScale versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations such as webhooks or scheduled agent workflows. Schema branching and deploy requests let teams version and review schema changes, and backups and point-in-time branches restore data. Those are adjacent database-change features, not controls over the automations themselves. Agent-opened pull requests are reviewable code changes, not versioned automation definitions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
